rules: If the SUM bit in the mstatus register is set, supervisor mode software may access pages with U=1 in the page table entry.
If the SUM bit in the mstatus register is clear, supervisor mode software will fault on accesses to pages with U=1 in the page table entry.
The requested memory access is allowed by the pte.u bit based on the current privilege mode and the value of the SUM field of the mstatus register.
The requested memory access is allowed by the pte.u bit based on the current privilege mode and the value of the MXR field of the mstatus register.
